Not all "pending" things show pending for everyone. I can thing of 3 or 4 big offers I've done (Dollar Shave Club being one, Vuse being another, Uber Ears was another) that never showed pending and still credited in the correct date or earlier. I've also seen people post frequently about the same happening with Lyft.

I wouldn't freak out until the 32 days have passed. It's only been 2. It's been 3 days since I made a purchase through Amazon that should have qualified for cash back and while the trip is showing, the purchase isn't yet. So again, don't stress yet.

I've never had a shopping that should pend not, I've had it where things that should qualify not qualify because of how they quantify the item (say as accessory instead of clothing item). But I have had big payout offers not pend. It seems to be half and half from what I've seen on those type of offers, people say it's pending and people saying it's not and majority get the payout.
